row.notes: Pointer to the CRITICAL_SECTION guarding the audio job worker mailboxes, g_Snd_JobWorkerOverflow and g_Snd_JobWorkerPending: Snd_Request_JobWorker enters it (0x143fbdd3e) and leaves it at its end (0x143fbde0d); Snd_Run_JobWorkerThread takes it around every pending-count read and overflow scan. The combined static initialiser 0x143fcbc30 stores it at 0x143fcc168 and calls InitializeCriticalSection on it at 0x143fcc16f and registers 0x143fbda40 with atexit (lea at 0x143fcc171), which deletes it (DeleteCriticalSection) at exit; the worker thread creator 0x152d7d570 (.data1) also holds it. A worker reads its own mailbox and clears its busy flag (+0x28) without the lock, so for the mailboxes the lock covers only the side that claims them.

V2190 Type void * and sig hold: sigcheck hits=1 at 0x143fbdd36, riprel target 0x146c63ba0 is the mov rcx loaded for EnterCriticalSection at 0x143fbdd45. Full scan of .xtls/.xtext/.data1 finds 13 code refs and no absolute pointers. Snd_Run_JobWorkerThread (7 refs) holds it for both pending reads (0x143fc65c3, 0x143fc6734), the flag scan, the flag clear and the pending decrement. The .data1 body 0x152d7d570 (thunk 0x143fc01e0) holds it from 0x152d7d5b8 to 0x152d7d6d6 while it creates the worker threads on Snd_Run_JobWorkerThread. WRONG: 0x143fbda43 does not hold it. 0x143fbda40 (no .pdata entry) is mov rcx,[lock]; jmp [DeleteCriticalSection] (IAT 0x145d3c210), the atexit destructor that the static init registers at 0x143fcc171 (call atexit 0x1449e071c at 0x143fcc178), so it deletes the section at exit. Minor: the worker reads its own mailbox fn and type (0x143fc65b1) and clears busy +0x28 (0x143fc676a, 0x143fc6788) without the lock, so for the mailboxes it guards only the claim side.

V2192 Blind re-derivation.
